idea-plugin.name: Git Branch Notes
idea-plugin.description:
Displays Git branch notes next to local branch names in IntelliJ IDEA.
  • Annotates local branches in the Git Log branch dashboard.
  • Shows the current branch and its note in the status bar.
  • Lets you edit, clear, and search branch notes from the status-bar popup.
  • Stores notes locally using Git's native branch.<name>.description configuration.
No external service or project file is required.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Initial JetBrains Marketplace release.
  • Displays local branch notes in the Git Log branch dashboard and status bar.
  • Supports editing, clearing, searching, and checking out local branches.
